description: Get refining and trading spreads: crack spreads (refining margin proxy), basis spreads (regional price differentials), and refinery margins, latest or as a daily history. Use when the user asks about crack spreads, 3-2-1 crack, refining margins, Brent-WTI, Waha or JKM/TTF vs Henry Hub basis. crack: crack_type 3-2-1|jet|diesel|gasoline (default 3-2-1) against crude BRENT_CRUDE_USD|WTI_USD|BRENT_SPOT_USD|WTI_SPOT_USD (default BRENT_CRUDE_USD). basis: pair WAHA_HH|BRENT_WTI|BRENT_DUBAI|JKM_HH|TTF_HH|BRENT_OMAN; omit pair to list every pair (/basis/all). margin: index usgc|singapore|nwe (default usgc). Pass start_date and/or end_date (YYYY-MM-DD) for daily history (backend default: last 30 days, capped at 2 years); basis history needs a pair. Requires an eligible account entitlement. Use opa_get_plans for current access and pricing; the API response is authoritative.

crack_type.description: type=crack only. 3-2-1 composite (default), or single-product jet, diesel (heating oil), gasoline (RBOB).

crude.description: type=crack only. Crude leg; default BRENT_CRUDE_USD (futures). *_SPOT_USD are spot.

end_date.description: Optional history end (YYYY-MM-DD). Switches to the daily historical series.

index.description: type=margin only. usgc (US Gulf Coast, default), singapore, or nwe (NW Europe).

pair.description: type=basis only. Hub/grade pair, e.g. BRENT_WTI, WAHA_HH, JKM_HH. Omit to list all pairs.

start_date.description: Optional history start (YYYY-MM-DD). Switches to the daily historical series.

type.description: Spread type: crack (refining crack spread, e.g. 3-2-1), basis (regional/grade price differential), or margin (composite refinery margin).

name: opa_get_spread
title: Get Refining & Trading Spreads
